item.title: The Amazon's future is on the ballot in Brazil. Many voters aren't focused on it
item.description: Brazil's environment is a global concern. But on the campaign trail, it's struggling to get voters' attention.
item.content:encoded: Brazil's environment is a global concern. But on the campaign trail, it's struggling to get voters' attention.

item.title: Brazil's election could shift its ties with the U.S. and China
item.description: Brazil is a global supplier of oil, soybeans and critical minerals. Americas Quarterly editor in chief Brian Winter explains how Brazil's presidential election could impact trade with the U.S. and China.
item.content:encoded: Brazil is a global supplier of oil, soybeans and critical minerals. Americas Quarterly editor in chief Brian Winter explains how Brazil's presidential election could impact trade with the U.S. and China.

item.title: Brazil votes, with Lula facing Bolsonaro's son
item.description: In Brazil, President Lula da Silva faces Flávio Bolsonaro, son of the jailed former president, in a tight race. If neither wins more than half the votes they'll face each other again on Oct. 25.

item.title: U.S. Marine arrested for alleged murder of a woman in Okinawa, Japan
item.description: Japanese police arrested a U.S. Marine in the alleged robbery and murder of a woman on Okinawa, officials said Sunday.

item.title: She died covering war for Fox News. Her parents blame the network — and a star reporter
item.description: The family members of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the war in Ukraine are suing the network, saying it put getting the story ahead of its people.

item.title: For some Brazilians, this election is a vote on Trump
item.description: President Trump says he's been having success winning races in Latin America. As Brazilian voters go to the polls, they're also deciding how much influence Trump should have in their country.

item.title: France arrests 5,000 people, mostly teens, as school protests spread
item.description: High school students say their classrooms are overcrowded, teachers are missing and buildings need repairs. The protests have spread to cities across France, and some 5,000 people have been arrested.

item.title: U.S. withdrawal from Iraq is complete
item.description: Twenty-three years after President George W. Bush's campaign of "shock and awe," the U.S. military has completed its withdrawal from Iraq.
item.content:encoded: Twenty-three years after President George W. Bush's campaign of "shock and awe," the U.S. military has completed its withdrawal from Iraq.

item.title: Lula or Bolsonaro? Some Brazilian voters say they don't want either
item.description: Brazil's election enters its final day of campaigning as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro make their last pitches to voters. Brazilians explain what worries them, and why some still can't choose.

item.title: Brazil's big political rematch: What to know about the Brazilian election
item.description: Four years after President Lula narrowly defeated Jair Bolsonaro, Brazil is back at the ballot box. This time, Lula faces Bolsonaro's son, Flávio, in a high-stakes rematch.
